_about: Real-world ad benchmarks used by `league simulate` as each venture's baseline. Currency USD (converted to CAD at live USDCAD when simulating). Values are medians of US campaigns as published.

sources.name: WordStream by LocaliQ - Google Ads Benchmarks 2026 (search: average CPC and conversion rate by industry)
sources.sample: 13,474 US search campaigns (Google Ads + Microsoft Ads), medians

sources.name: WordStream by LocaliQ - Facebook Ads Benchmarks 2025 (traffic-campaign CPC by industry; leads-campaign CVR by industry)

not_sourced.average_order_or_lead_value: Not published per industry in these sources - the referee sets each venture's value per sale at review.
not_sourced.note: Local-services and display channels use the engine's original constants (ESTIMATES, not sourced). Ventures with an unknown industry use the original flat constants for all channels (search 1.60, social 0.90 CAD) and the referee's --conv.
